397e91c54aa0107a244d42b78d6f4094879bbbe2.summary: Report says Chinese state-backed group Silk Typhoon (also called Hafnium) reportedly breached a Treasury Department office that reviews foreign investments (CFIUS). OFAC was also breached using a stolen BeyondTrust Remote Support API key. Bloomberg attributed the attack to Silk Typhoon. CISA said the breach did not impact other federal agencies. The impact on the Office of Financial Research is still being assessed. The group became widely known after exploiting ProxyLogon flaws in 2021, compromising an estimated 68,500 servers.
